topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic welcomes students, introduces the lecture's focus on cancer evolution and the microenvironment, and outlines key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic mutations and epigenetic changes confer competitive selective advantages that drive clonal expansion and tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchy and the differentiation state of the cell of origin influence cancer initiation and stem-like propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how microenvironmental signals, inflammatory promoters, and supportive stroma facilitate tumor outgrowth and maintain malignancy.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the sequencing, computational, and spatial omics methods used to study cancer evolution and cell-microenvironment interactions in the lab.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Multi-Factor Evolutionary Framework of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's core themes into a unified model where genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors co-evolve to drive malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic concludes the presentation and provides framing for the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
